rows.line: 取材をすればするほど、自由な手足が縛られていって
rows.en1: The more I research, the more boxed in I get.
rows.en2: The more I dig, the less room I have.

rows.line: 僕、割と型にはめてしまうタイプなんで
rows.en1: I tend to box myself in.
rows.en2: I end up sticking to a formula.

rows.line: あのやっぱ知っちゃうと
rows.en1: Once you know, you know.
rows.en2: Once you know too much...

rows.line: いや、ありえないでしょって思っちゃうんだろうな
rows.en1: They'd be like, no way, that'd never happen.
rows.en2: They'd go, come on, that's ridiculous.

rows.line: やっぱ現実がちらっとちらついちゃう
rows.en1: Reality keeps creeping in.
rows.en2: The real world keeps sneaking back in.

rows.line: そこのせめぎ合いは書くたびに悩むんですよね
rows.en1: I go back and forth on that every time.
rows.en2: It's a tug-of-war every single time.

rows.line: 意外と私、作るの苦手だったりするので
rows.en1: Believe it or not, I'm not great at that.
rows.en2: Funny enough, that's not really my thing.

rows.line: やっぱ無理だなって思っちゃうの、辛いものがありますからね
rows.en1: That's a tough pill to swallow.
rows.en2: That kind of hurts.

rows.line: 意外と1番いい着地なんじゃないかな
rows.en1: That might actually be the sweet spot.
rows.en2: Turns out that's the best way to land it.

rows.ja: 最初はそんなつもりじゃなかったのに
rows.line: やっぱり最初はそんなつもりじゃなかったのに
rows.en1: I didn't plan on it at first, but...
rows.en2: That wasn't the idea going in.

rows.line: セリフがすらすら出てくるようになったら
rows.en1: once the lines start flowing
rows.en2: when the dialogue just comes out

rows.ja: 好き嫌いでジャッジしない
rows.line: 主人公ってなんかこう、好き嫌いであんまりジャッジしない
rows.en1: I don't really judge them on whether I like them.
rows.en2: It's not about liking them or not.

rows.ja: 役割を背負わされてる
rows.line: 主人公ってなんか役割を背負わされてますから
rows.en1: The main character's got a job to do.
rows.en2: They're stuck carrying the whole story.

rows.line: 特殊な名前を作りたいわけじゃないんだけれど
rows.en1: It's not like I want some crazy name, but...
rows.en2: I'm not going for anything weird, but...

rows.line: みんな読める字を使って、でもちょっと印象に残る名前
rows.en1: something that sticks with you
rows.en2: a name people actually remember

rows.line: キラキラまではいかないけれど、でもやっぱ今っぽい
rows.en1: Not over-the-top, but...
rows.en2: It's not quite flashy, but...

rows.line: 重松さんを皮切りに
rows.en1: That's where it all started.
rows.en2: After that, it just snowballed.

rows.line: いつの間にか、振り返ってみると読んでたのが
rows.en1: Looking back...
rows.en2: When I think about it now...

rows.line: 気がつけばなんかここに座ってるって感じですよね
rows.en1: Next thing I know, here I am.
rows.en2: Somehow I ended up here.

rows.line: 普遍的なものが今もあると信じて書くしかないな
rows.en1: All I can do is trust that and write.
rows.en2: I just have to believe it and go.

rows.line: どんな感じなんだろうっていうのを見たいがためにやってる
rows.en1: Honestly, I do it just so I can see.
rows.en2: Part of why I do it is just to see.

rows.line: 狭い人間関係の中で、こうやきもきしたりとか
rows.en1: getting all worked up over small stuff
rows.en2: stressing about who's mad at who

rows.line: 何かになりたいのになれないみたいなジレンマ
rows.en1: wanting to be something and not getting there
rows.en2: You want to be somebody, but you just can't.

rows.ja: 置き換えて読んじゃう
rows.line: 何かこうあの置き換えて、やっぱり読んじゃうんですよね
rows.en1: You end up reading yourself into it.
rows.en2: You can't help putting yourself in there.

rows.line: 青春小説とはって語るのはちょっと恥ずかしいな
rows.en1: I'd feel kind of dumb lecturing about it.
rows.en2: It's a little embarrassing to go on about it.

rows.ja: 違うけど似たようなこと
rows.line: 違うけど似たようなことあったなみたいな
rows.en1: Not the same, but I had something like that.
rows.en2: Different, but been there.

rows.line: 結局人間って、18歳ぐらいで悩むことって実は似てる
rows.en1: At the end of the day, it's all the same stuff.
rows.en2: When it comes down to it, everybody stresses about the same things.

rows.line: 6時間ぐらいずっとなんかダラダラケラケラしてます
rows.en1: just hanging out, goofing off for hours
rows.en2: killing time and cracking up

rows.line: なんならみんなで集まってプラモデルとか作ってましたもん
rows.en1: If anything, they were all building model kits together.
rows.en2: They were even sitting around building models.

rows.line: なんか意外と変わんないものがあって
rows.en1: Some things really don't change.
rows.en2: Turns out it's not that different.

rows.line: 大人にならざるを得ないっていうか
rows.en1: You had no choice but to grow up.
rows.en2: You just had to grow up.

rows.line: 青春時代を長引かせているか、こじらせているか
rows.en1: dragging it out or letting it get messy
rows.en2: stuck in it, or it's gone sideways

rows.ja: ネタバレにならないように
rows.line: まあネタバレにならないようにお話をすると
rows.en1: Without spoiling anything...
rows.en2: No spoilers, but...

rows.line: 言っても別に間違っちゃないんだなっていう
rows.en1: It's not wrong, really.
rows.en2: I guess that's fair to say.

rows.line: 結構頑張ってんのよ、年してから高校に通うんだよ
rows.en1: We're trying pretty hard, you know.
rows.en2: Hey, we're putting in the work.
